text: Date:22-07-2026 NOTICE Attention OBC students Online Application (Fresh /Renewal) for the year 202 6-27 are invited for the National Scholarship for Higher Education for OBC students PM YASASVI CENTRAL SECTOR SCHEME OF TOP CLASS EDUCATION IN COLLEGE FOR OBC, EBC AND DNT STUDENTS. All UG students (including higher semester) students whose total annual family income from all sources is less than Rs. 2.50 lakh are eligible to apply for this scholarship. Interested and eligible students are required to apply online through National Scholarship Portal (NSP) www.scholarships.gov.in • No. of slots for OBC/EBC/DNT students: 62 Eligibility: i. Annual family income from all sources up to Rs.2.50 lakh ii. Top 62 OBC, EBC and DNT students (JEE Mains Rank) iii. All eligible B. Tech students (including higher semester) can apply Scholarship Details: i. Tuition Fees ii. Non- refundable charges iii. Rs. 3000/- (living expenses) per month iv. Rs. 5000/- (books & stationery) per annum v. Rs. 45000/- laptop (one time) The expenditure certificate required for the online application can be obtained from the Institute by following the steps given below: I. Expenditure Certificate: 1. Download the format from the NITK website: (https://www.nitk.ac.in/certificates--transcript 2. Fill -in the personal details (e.g., Name, Date of admission, semester, Branch etc.) 3. The filled-in form has to be submitted to academic section- E7 4. You will receive a completed expenditure certificate from the academic section after 2 days The completed online application after submission to the NSP portal has to be printed, and the signed copy of the application along with all the supporting documents (Income, Caste certificate, previous year marks sheet, Expenditure certificate) should be submitted to the SC-ST Cell office. -Sd- Liaison Officer OBC Cell NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KARNATAKA, SURATHKAL Srinivasnagar, Mangaluru 575025, Karnataka, India
